title: A little-known Croatian startup is coming for the robotaxi market with help from Uber | TechCrunch
summary: Mate Rimac's vision for an urban robotaxi service using purpose-built electric vehicles is progressing with a strategic partnership to launch a commercial service in Europe, starting in Zagreb, Croatia. Verne, a company within Rimac Group, will operate the fleet and manage the infrastructure, with Uber and Pony.ai providing the ride-hailing network and autonomous driving system, respectively.
sentiment_reason: The collaboration between major companies in the electric vehicle and autonomous driving space for a new service indicates a positive development and potential growth in the market.
